description:
Moku is a fast, minimal manga reader frontend for Suwayomi-Server.


Moku is a fast, minimal manga reader frontend for Suwayomi-Server.

It wraps Suwayomi's GraphQL API in a lightweight Tauri app — no Electron overhead.
# Moku v0.12.0
**Released:** September 12, 2026
> "Authentication is here."

## Highlights
• **Authentication support**, along with auth consolidation across the app
• **AniList library import**, letting users pull their AniList manga and anime lists directly into Moku, including import as library stubs without a source
• **Tachiyomi backup support** for importing existing backups

## New Features
• Added an AniList library import modal with language selection and anime support
• Added Tachiyomi backup support
• Added a PKGBUILD for git based Moku builds

## Improvements
• Split tracker migration logic for more reliable handling
• Streamlined the resume banner layout in the Tracker Import Modal
• Improved language selection in import modals
• Improved AnimePlayer UX
• Fixed the extensions switch for better UX

## Bug Fixes
• Fixed the download directory setting

## Notes
• Auth is newly added, please report any issues encountered
• Cloudflare/Flaresolverr support is functional but pending broader user testing
• Anime player upscaling is still work in progress and untested
• Dropdown menu portal rework still in progress (#102)
• "Update All" button issue still under investigation (#105)
• App data wipe on update still under investigation (#104)
• Downloads recognition on open still under investigation (#103)

## New Contributors
• @Gregorein made their first contribution with AniList library import in #124

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/moku-project/Moku/compare/v0.11.5...v0.12.0
